title: REQ · rejectExecution client call POSTs to the reject endpoint
description: Add rejectExecution(token, id) in client.ts that POSTs /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/reject using adminRequest, mirroring approveExecution, so AdminApp has a matching client call for Reject.
acceptance_criteria: Given token and id, when rejectExecution is called, then fetch receives POST /api/v1/admin/executions/{id}/reject with Authorization 'Bearer {token}'
Given a 401 response, when rejectExecution is called, then it rejects with ApiError status 401
technical_constraints: Reuse adminRequest; id is passed through encodeURIComponent
definition_of_done: rejectExecution exported and typed to return ExecutionInfo
